messages:
Alex P: Heads-up — the onboarding quickstart is showing a 503 for the screenshots section (https://kb.redwood.ai/onboarding/quickstart). Also noticed an internal anchor to #runtime that 404s when clicked.
DocsBot: automated-scan: asset fetch failed 503 for https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/rw-kb-assets/onboarding/quickstart/screenshot-01.png — first seen 2026-03-16T18:02:12Z
Maya G: who is owning this page atm? I can do a tiny fix if someone points at the correct image source or we just rehost a fallback.
Kevin L: I can take it. probably a signed-url expiry or object perms. can you drop the s3 key, Alex?
Alex P: s3 key is rw-kb-assets/onboarding/quickstart/screenshot-01.png
Alex P: curl output when fetching from the CDN:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/onboarding/quickstart/screenshot-01.png
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-cache: Error from cloudfront
```
Maya G: looks like CDN upstream returned 503. Quick options: reupload to long-ttl path or replace with placeholder and add a note in the page to avoid 3rd-party hotlinks.
Sam R: FYI the image uploader issues an expiring signed URL for private buckets. If a rehost is ok, we can move the file to the public-assets bucket and update the CDN origin. That requires a tiny infra change (I can do it) or Kevin can replace with an S3-hosted public copy as a stopgap.
Kevin L: I'll open a small PR to replace the image path with the public copy and add alt text. pinging @Maya for review. PR will also add a short QA step in the page about checking images load.
Maya G: great — please add the docs:editor label and include a preview link. I'll review after lunch.
Kevin L: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8421 — changes:
- swap screenshot-01.png -> /public-assets/onboarding/quickstart/screenshot-01.png
- add alt text and caption
- add QA checklist item: "verify images render in preview"
DeployBot: preview deployed: https://preview.kb.redwood.ai/pr-8421/onboarding/quickstart
Alex P: checked preview — images load, anchor to #runtime works after I updated the relative link to /docs/runtime/overview
Kevin L: thanks all. I'll merge once Maya gives the thumbs-up, then Sam if you want to follow up on the public-assets origin we can make it permanent.
Maya G: reviewed and approved. left one nit about caption phrasing, pushed suggestion to the PR.
Kevin L: addressed nit, rebased, ready to merge.
Alex P: going to close this thread when merged. thanks :thumbsup:
